name: TestPion Examples
description: Ready-to-run examples of every kind of test against free public APIs: REST (httpbin, JSONPlaceholder, Swagger Petstore), GraphQL (Countries, Rick and Morty), gRPC (grpcb.in), WebSocket (echo servers), Server-Sent Events (Wikimedia), MCP (Petstore MCP, DeepWiki, an offline mock), AI prompts, evaluations, safety, RAG and an agent (offline demo model). Open a request and press Send, or run a collection or test suite.
